Subject: Post-call recap & POC onramp — Pacifica Health

Thanks again for the time this morning — really appreciated the candid discussion. Below is a condensed recap and a proposed onramp plan so we can get the POC started next week if that works for you.

Key pain & goals (as discussed)
- High false-positive rate in triage triage pipeline; manual review backlog grows 30% q/q.
- Need consistent extraction of patient notes (structured fields: reason for visit, meds, comorbidities) from clinician notes.
- Goal: reduce manual triage time by 40% and improve extraction precision to >90% on key fields.

Proposed POC scope (attached: pacifica_poc_scope_v1.pdf)
- Dataset: 8k de-identified notes (sample provided by Pacifica).
- Model: Redwood-verified open LLM (quantized variant) + custom prompt set + evaluation harness.
- Success metrics: precision/recall on 6 extraction fields, avg latency < 300ms per request at target batch sizes, and human-in-the-loop error rate below 10%.
- Duration: 4 weeks (2 weeks model tuning + 2 weeks evaluation/ops).

Owners & requests
- Pacifica: provide ACL for S3 sample bucket, access to schema doc, and point person for annotations (Daniel).
- Redwood: Priya (AE) — customer liaison; Priyom (Solutions Eng) — infra & prompt tuning; Marissa (CS) — eval harness & quality checks.

Immediate next steps (please confirm by EOD):
1) Pacifica: confirm dataset delivery timeline and who will be the annotation lead.
2) Pacifica: approve the scope doc (attached) and the access checklist (access_onramp_checklist.xlsx).
3) Redwood: will provision a dedicated sandbox environment once Access is granted; expect 48–72 hours after we receive credentials.

If you want any changes to metrics or scope, call me and we’ll update the doc. If it looks good, can we kick off Monday 27 Jul?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
